title: Gundam Card Game heads to PAX Unplugged
summary: Learn to Play demo decks and Event Sealed Battles at PAX Unplugged in Philadelphia, December 4-6, 2026.

title: Mega Rayquaza ex gets a Premium Tournament Collection
summary: The Pokémon Company's Mega Rayquaza ex box releases February 12, 2027, with four foil promos, eight booster packs and Dragon Shield sleeves.

title: Yu-Gi-Oh!'s Maze of Machines lands March 2027
summary: Konami's 153-card booster set releases March 19, 2027, with Rampant Barrel Dragon, Slot Machine 777 and 10 new Yu-Gi-Oh! GX cards.

title: Goldin's Pokémon 30th auction passes $28 million
summary: Goldin's October 25 auction had 18 record sales, led by a PSA 10 Art Academy Mudkip promo at $4.88 million and a Trophy Pikachu over $3 million.

title: Star Trek gets a Secret Lair Superdrop
summary: "Set Phasers to Superdrop" brings five Star Trek-themed Secret Lair drops, with direct preorders opening November 9.

title: Dual Fusion is out in TCG Pocket
summary: The expansion launched October 28, debuting dual-type cards led by Mega Mewtwo X ex and Mega Greninja ex.

title: Reality Fracture bundle delayed
summary: The Reality Fracture Secret Lair Bundle is delayed by shipping and production issues, after the Star Trek Commander Decks slipped first.

title: Into the Inkdark opens for preorder
summary: Disney Lorcana's next set is expected February 12, 2027, with the first serialized Illustrious cards.

title: Chorus of Steel lands October 30
summary: Smash Palace brings back Ultimate Pit Fight multiplayer with two new heroes, Zane and Killjoy.

title: Doug Ferguson's collection heads to auction
summary: Items from the collection go up for auction on November 3, led by a jumbo graded card of Doug himself.

title: Dracule Mihawk OP14-020 is banned
summary: The leader card is banned, alternate arts included, and the ban is now in effect.

title: Deck Crafter's Collection is out now
summary: A box packed with competitive staples; Lorcana's Collection Quests also head to Disney Cruise Line ships in 2027.

title: UK collection sells for over $2 million
summary: A UK collector's Pokémon cards reportedly sold for a UK record.
